big_case.notes: Cert granted 2026-07-20: the Court's first plenary vehicle on the Bajakajian excessiveness standard since 1998, IJ-litigated with Cato/Colgan/Timbs amici, setting the gravity-of-the-offense methodology for fines and forfeitures nationwide. Significant constitutional-criminal/property question, though the QP is methodological and the stakes modest in dollar terms.
